_comment: FEATURE: Station Navigator. HONEST NOTE (same rule as advanced_features.py's platform navigation guide): no Indian Railways station publishes a real indoor-facility map through any API this app can reach. `entrance_sides` is only ever filled in for a handful of very well-documented major-terminus stations where the named entrances/sides are genuinely public, widely-published facts (e.g. New Delhi's Ajmeri Gate vs Paharganj side) - every other station is left as an empty list rather than guessed. `notable_note` is the same kind of well-known public fact (e.g. a station's two separate complexes), never a guess about a specific shop/counter location. Everything about WHICH platform a specific amenity sits on is deliberately NOT included here - that's exactly the kind of precise indoor-layout fact this project's honesty rule (see advanced_features.py's module docstring) won't fabricate. The backend composes this real-but-sparse data with generic, clearly-labelled Indian-station-layout conventions (see advanced_features.station_navigator) rather than inventing precise positions.

NDLS.name: New Delhi
entrance_sides: Ajmeri Gate side (south) — closer to Paharganj/Main Bazar
Paharganj side (north) — closer to Chelmsford Road
NDLS.notable_note: One of India's busiest stations, with two named entrance sides serving opposite ends of the station.

HWH.name: Howrah Jn
HWH.notable_note: Split into two physically separate complexes joined by a connecting passage — check which complex your platform is in.

CSMT.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus
entrance_sides: Main heritage building entrance (facing Dr Dadabhai Naoroji Road)
CSMT.notable_note: A UNESCO World Heritage building; the main entrance/circulating area fronts the road, with all platforms behind it.

MAS.name: Chennai Central
entrance_sides: Main entrance (EVR Periyar Salai / Wall Tax Road side)
MAS.notable_note: Adjacent to (but a separate station from) Chennai Egmore — don't confuse the two when booking a cab/auto.

LKO.name: Lucknow NR (Charbagh)
LKO.notable_note: The building's distinctive dome-and-chhatri architecture is a well-known Lucknow landmark.
